title: A brick stable behind the 1700-1706 Prairie pair
items: The alley behind the Glessner-Lee and George Glessner townhouses at 1700-1706 Prairie now has its two-storey brick stable, the longest on that alley: 19.4 m along it and 10.4 m deep, with a fire wall on the lot line to the north and a window pair at the middle of its alley wall. Its outline, storeys, brick and window place come from the 1911 Sanborn sheet, and Robinson's 1886 atlas draws the same stable, so it stood through 1904. The doors, loft hatch, other windows and roof are reconstructed from the shared coach-house kit and listed in the liberties.
